plugins.name: sawbuck-reins
plugins.description: Find the rules you keep telling your agent, write them down, and re-run your tests to prove they held. One install wires six slash commands: /sawbuck-reins:rules (the rules you keep enforcing), /sawbuck-reins:shape (what you push on), /sawbuck-reins:audit (rules that pull against each other), /sawbuck-reins:contract (give the repo its rules and watch every turn), /sawbuck-reins:check (verify now), /sawbuck-reins:status (what it caught), plus the sawbuck guide band (watching / N caught / last verdict / steer rate). The mod runs no program; the commands run the pinned sawbuck CLI through Claude's own Bash tool.
